exposure: future birth intention at the health facility
cohort: 370 postpartum women in secondary-level healthcare institutions in the South West Region of Ethiopia
finding: Only one-fourth of women experienced a high level of respectful maternity care during childbirth, with factors like education, time of delivery, mode of delivery and future birth intention at the facility being associated with the experience.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth through caesarean section had a higher likelihood of reporting respectful maternity care (adjusted OR 2.19, 95% CI 1.410 to 3.404).
